what: pb is a clipboard helper for AI coding agents. It copies the last useful artifact, such as a command, query or code block, to the system clipboard through /pb or plain language.
audience: Developers who use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf and Copilot.
landing_job: Get the reader to install pb in about one minute, then stop selecting text by hand.

identity.look: The landing page uses one butter-and-crust palette with a system font stack, a large amber hero and a plain text wordmark. Other docs pages use other palettes.

v2_case: The docs site uses three palettes: butter on the landing page (docs/index.html:19), dark grey on the clipboard-lab review (docs/clipboard-lab-review.html:10), and sea and sand on the seashells tour (docs/seashells-tour.html:22-23). The hero fails contrast: white text on #E8A317 is 2.17:1 by my calculation (docs/index.html:57, 77).
notes: No design-system folder, tokens or brand book exist. The logo is a plain-type wordmark with a CSS butter-pat shape (docs/index.html:35), not an image file. Formalize the landing palette first, then fix the hero contrast in v2.
